title: Lattice-Based Pruning of Recurrent Neural Networks via Poset Modeling: A Corrected Theory and a Matched-Sparsity Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2502.16525v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Magnitude pruning of recurrent neural networks (RNNs) ignores how information flows between neurons. An earlier version proposed to model RNN dependencies as a partially ordered set (poset) and to retain the meet-irreducible elements of its dependency lattice. By Birkhoff's representation theorem, the meet-irreducible ideals of a finite poset are in bijection with its elements, so retaining them retains everything; the critical-set criterion used earlier selects precisely the elements comparable to all others, of which a dense recurrent layer has none. Condensing a thresholded dependency graph into strongly connected components yields a well-defined dependency order, a graded order score and an acyclic pruning rule; for Cohen-Grossberg networks and LSTMs, acyclic pruning makes local stability decompose over modules. translated_title: 基于偏序集建模的循环神经网络格剪枝：修正理论与匹配稀疏度评估
translated_abstract: 对循环神经网络（RNN）的幅值剪枝忽略了神经元之间信息流动的方式。早期版本提出将RNN的依赖关系建模为偏序集，并保留其依赖格中的交不可约元素。然而根据Birkhoff表示定理，有限偏序集的交不可约理想与其元素一一对应，因此保留它们就等于保留了全部元素；早期使用的临界集准则恰好选出的是与所有其他元素都可比的元素，而稠密循环层中不存在这样的元素。将阈值化后的依赖图凝聚为强连通分量，可以得到明确定义的依赖序、分级序得分以及无环剪枝规则；对于Cohen-Grossberg网络和LSTM，无环剪枝使局部稳定性可以按模块进行分解。对于一个128单元的LSTM，在行式输入与分块输入的顺序MNIST任务上以匹配稀疏度进行剪枝（三个随机种子，相同的训练设置……
tldr: 本文修正了此前基于偏序集的RNN剪枝理论中的缺陷（原临界集准则在稠密循环层中选不出任何元素），提出通过将依赖图凝聚为强连通分量得到无环剪枝规则，使局部稳定性可按模块分解，并在匹配稀疏度条件下验证了剪枝效果。
en_tdlr: This paper corrects flaws in a poset-based RNN pruning theory—showing the prior critical-set criterion selects nothing in dense recurrent layers—and proposes an acyclic pruning rule via condensing the dependency graph into strongly connected components, enabling module-wise decomposition of local stability and matching-sparsity evaluation.
